fields.accordion-title-solutions-html: How does take-away or table service work for visitors?
fields.rt-faq-html: Each table or zone is equipped with a unique QR code. Visitors scan it with their smartphone to access a personalized ordering interface, with no application to download. They can view the menu, order and pay directly from their phone.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-2: What are the advantages of digitizing fleet restoration?
fields.rt-faq-html-2: Innovorder offers a suite of solutions designed to cope with the complex flows and peak numbers typical of theme parks. Central checkout, autonomous ordering, mobile payment: everything is connected, fluid and customizable. You gain in efficiency, your visitors spend less time waiting, and your sales naturally increase.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-3: Can I track my sales and performance in real time?
fields.rt-faq-html-3: Yes, the Innovorder back-office lets you monitor your sales, by zone or by product, in real time. You can visualize your performance, adjust your teams or your offer according to traffic, and manage your entire site remotely.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-4: What solutions are available to equip my theme park?
fields.rt-faq-html-4:
Innovorder offers a complete ecosystem to streamline catering in high-traffic environments such as theme parks.

An all-in-one cash register to centralize orders for all your points of sale: stands, restaurants, food trucks or kiosks. Simultaneous control, even during peak periods. Mobile ordering or via QR code, ideal for queues or rest areas: your visitors place their orders in advance, without leaving their seats, speeding up service and reducing congestion. Order kiosks placed in strategic areas of the park (entrance, snack zone, major attractions), to take orders at any time of day, without having to call on your staff. Connected production display (KDS): displays orders to your kitchen or counter staff in real time, to ensure fast, error-free service, even during peak periods.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-5: What are the advantages of digitizing fleet restoration?
fields.rt-faq-html-5: Digitizing your fleet's catering means greater operational efficiency. By automating order-taking, preparation and payment, you can streamline your organization and free up precious time for your teams. The result: faster service, a better customer experience and a naturally higher average basket.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-6: Can I track my sales live during peak periods?
fields.rt-faq-html-6: Yes, you have access to a real-time dashboard that lets you adjust your decisions immediately.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-7: Can I connect the cash register to a reservation or ticketing system?
fields.rt-faq-html-7: No, Innovorder does not manage reservation or ticketing systems, but can operate in parallel without interfering with them.
